notes.title: Ittle Dew 2+ "Dream World" free update on Steam!
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce that Ittle Dew 2+ with the huge Dream World expansion is now live on Steam as a free update!

[b]New in Ittle Dew 2+ (originally released on Nintendo Switch):[/b]
[list]
[*] :hype: Dream world added, a new area with five dungeons focusing on puzzles. To enter the dream world, first collect a Raft piece, then find the sleeping bag in Fluffy Fields.
[*] :hype: Collectible cards added, which are found in the dream world dungeons.
[*] :hype: Completing all caves and dungeons in an overworld area will cause a checkmark to appear on the overworld map. Please note that some areas are divided into several sub-areas, which now have unique names.
[*] :hype: Reduced amount of enemies on the overworld. We wanted to make them stay defeated as you go in and out of caves and dungeons, but that sadly wasn't possible with the way the game is built.
[*] :hype:Slightly lowered the hit points of many tougher enemies and most bosses.
[*] :hype: Certain "boss enemies" fire slightly less projectiles.
[*] :hype: Tweaked several dungeon rooms.
[*] :hype: Jenny Berry's outfit is now found inside her house. The old code will still work however.
[/list]

[b]Also new in this enhanced Steam version of Ittle Dew 2+:[/b]
[list]
[*] :hype: Added an Easy Mode where you take less damage. You can switch it on or off from the pause menu at any time.
[*] :hype: The warps in Warp Garden now tell you where they lead.
[*] :hype: Added Swedish translation.
[*] :hype: Bug fixes, text tweaks and other improvements.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy this free update! We had a blast making it! :hype: :woo:

Oh and for you lovely, awesome speedrunners out there, if you wish to run "Vanilla" Ittle Dew 2, there will be a branch for you to play on. Stay tuned for an announcement on that too.

notes.title: Update 1.01 live now!
notes.notes:
Changelog 1.01:
* Added a hint in Lonely Road
* Speech Bubbles stay inside screen bounds
* Save files can handle save name with spaces
* Fixed map markers
* Game version shown in Title Screen
* Fix for a secret
* Settings now default to highest Quality instead of lowest
* A fix for Steam Cloud that prevented downloading older file format
